en: Sepia-toned vintage view of a quiet residential street with multi‑storey houses on both sides, fenced front gardens, telegraph poles, and a single overhead streetlamp suspended on wires. A small child stands with a dog in the foreground on the left. Trees line the street and low hills are visible in the distance. The caption at the bottom reads "Coswig i. Sa. Spitzgrundstraße".
